attributes.title: Do you come here often?
attributes.text: Do you come here often? Any element of a tuple can be accessed in constant time. Messages can be sent to and received from ports, but these messages must obey the so-called "port protocol." Erlang is known for its designs that are well suited for systems. Where are my pants?
attributes.attachment: The Galactic Empire is nearing completion of the Death Star, a space station with the power to destroy entire planets.

topic.name: Snort Rule
topic.description: Ports are used to communicate with the external world.
